quests.instruction: Arrange the words to react to good news enthusiastically.
quests.correctAnswer: That's so great , I'm really happy for you !
quests.hint: The sentence ends with 'you', right before the period.
quests.explanation: Two short clauses are joined by a comma to react warmly to someone's good news.

quests.instruction: Order the words to tell a story about a family gathering.
quests.correctAnswer: We all got together last weekend for dinner .
quests.hint: Look at how it starts -- 'We' comes first.
quests.explanation: 'Got together' is a common phrasal verb for meeting as a group.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to describe a frustrating shopping trip.
quests.correctAnswer: Nothing on my list was even available .
quests.hint: This sentence has 8 words -- spot 'Nothing' and 'available' first, then fill in the middle.
quests.explanation: 'Even' adds emphasis, showing the situation was worse than expected.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to compare two dishes.
quests.correctAnswer: This dish is spicier than the one I had before .
quests.hint: This one's 11 words long, ending in 'before' -- read the meaning first, then decide what comes first.
quests.explanation: '-er than' compares two things using a short adjective like 'spicy'.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say you pulled an all-nighter.
quests.correctAnswer: I stayed up all night studying for finals .
quests.hint: Start with 'I'.
quests.explanation: 'Stayed up' is the everyday phrase for not going to sleep.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to say a meeting ran over time.
quests.correctAnswer: Our meeting ran way over time today .
quests.hint: The first word is 'Our', out of 8 words total.
quests.explanation: 'Ran over time' means a meeting lasted longer than it was scheduled for.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to react to seeing trip photos.
quests.correctAnswer: Wow , your photos look absolutely incredible !
quests.hint: Once you place 'Wow' first, the other 7 words should start falling into place.
quests.explanation: 'Absolutely' before a strong adjective like 'incredible' adds real enthusiasm.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say an app stopped working.
quests.correctAnswer: The app suddenly stopped working this morning .
quests.hint: This 8-word sentence begins with 'The'.
quests.explanation: 'Stopped' is followed by the '-ing' form to show an activity that ended.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to describe recovering from an illness.
quests.correctAnswer: I'm finally starting to feel like myself again .
quests.hint: This is a 9-word statement ending in 'again' -- find the subject first, then the verb.
quests.explanation: 'Feel like myself' is an idiom meaning to feel normal or healthy again.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to compare two shows.
quests.correctAnswer: This series is way better than the last one .
quests.hint: The second word is 'series', right after 'This'.
quests.explanation: 'The last one' refers back to a show already mentioned, avoiding repetition.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say something happened by surprise.
quests.correctAnswer: I wasn't expecting that at all !
quests.hint: Work backward: 'all' is the last word before the period.
quests.explanation: 'Wasn't expecting' (past continuous) describes a state that the surprise interrupted.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to say a friend surprised you.
quests.correctAnswer: My best friend showed up completely unannounced .
quests.hint: There are 8 words in total -- start by placing 'My' first.
quests.explanation: 'Unannounced' means without warning, and comes after the verb 'showed up'.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to compare two products.
quests.correctAnswer: This brand is way better than the other one .
quests.hint: This one's 10 words long, ending in 'one' -- read the meaning first, then decide what comes first.
quests.explanation: 'Way' is an informal intensifier meaning 'much', common in casual speech.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say you tried cooking something new.
quests.correctAnswer: I tried making sushi for the first time .
quests.hint: The sentence ends with 'time', right before the period.
quests.explanation: 'Tried' is followed by the '-ing' form when describing an attempt at something.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to say a teacher gave helpful feedback.
quests.correctAnswer: My teacher gave me some really helpful feedback .
quests.hint: The first word is 'My', out of 9 words total.
quests.explanation: 'Feedback' is uncountable, so it's used with 'some' rather than 'a feedback'.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to react to a colleague's promotion.
quests.correctAnswer: That's fantastic news , congratulations to you !
quests.hint: This sentence has 8 words -- spot 'That's' and 'you' first, then fill in the middle.
quests.explanation: 'Congratulations to you' is a warm, direct way to celebrate someone's achievement.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say a flight was delayed.
quests.correctAnswer: Our flight was delayed by several hours .
quests.hint: Look at how it starts -- 'Our' comes first.
quests.explanation: 'Delayed by' is followed by an amount of time to show how late something was.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to describe binge-watching a show.
quests.correctAnswer: I ended up watching the whole season yesterday .
quests.hint: Once you place 'I' first, the other 8 words should start falling into place.
quests.explanation: 'Ended up' shows an unplanned result, like watching more than you meant to.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to compare how you feel today vs yesterday.
quests.correctAnswer: I feel so much better than yesterday .
quests.hint: This is a 8-word statement ending in 'yesterday' -- find the subject first, then the verb.
quests.explanation: 'So much better than' emphasizes a big improvement over a short time.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say you picked up a new hobby.
quests.correctAnswer: I actually picked up painting last month .
quests.hint: Work backward: 'month' is the last word before the period.
quests.explanation: 'Picked up' is a phrasal verb meaning to start learning or doing something.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to describe how your morning went wrong.
quests.correctAnswer: Everything went wrong this morning , honestly .
quests.hint: The second word is 'went', right after 'Everything'.
quests.explanation: 'Honestly' at the end adds a casual, sincere tone to a complaint.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to compare siblings.
quests.correctAnswer: My sister is much taller than me .
quests.hint: There are 8 words in total -- start by placing 'My' first.
quests.explanation: 'Much taller than' intensifies the comparison between two people.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say you waited in a long line.
quests.correctAnswer: I waited in line for almost an hour .
quests.hint: Start with 'I'.
quests.explanation: 'Almost' shows the time was close to, but not quite, a full hour.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to say a meal took too long to arrive.
quests.correctAnswer: Our food took forever to actually arrive .
quests.hint: This 8-word sentence begins with 'Our'.
quests.explanation: 'Took forever' is a common exaggeration meaning something felt like it took a very long time.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to react to good exam results.
quests.correctAnswer: That's amazing , you must be so relieved !
quests.hint: This sentence has 9 words -- spot 'That's' and 'relieved' first, then fill in the middle.
quests.explanation: 'Must be' expresses a confident guess about how someone probably feels.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say a project was stressful.
quests.correctAnswer: That project was honestly pretty stressful overall .
quests.hint: This one's 8 words long, ending in 'overall' -- read the meaning first, then decide what comes first.
quests.explanation: 'Overall' summarizes a general feeling about the whole experience.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to describe a memorable travel moment.
quests.correctAnswer: Watching the sunset there was truly unforgettable .
quests.hint: The first word is 'Watching', out of 8 words total.
quests.explanation: An '-ing' phrase ('Watching the sunset') can act as the subject of a sentence.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to compare two phones.
quests.correctAnswer: This camera is way better than my old one .
quests.hint: The sentence ends with 'one', right before the period.
quests.explanation: 'One' replaces the noun 'camera' to avoid repeating it.

quests.instruction: Order the words to say a workout was tough.
quests.correctAnswer: That workout was honestly tougher than expected .
quests.hint: Once you place 'That' first, the other 7 words should start falling into place.
quests.explanation: 'Tougher' is the comparative form of the adjective 'tough'.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to say an event sold out fast.
quests.correctAnswer: Tickets sold out faster than we expected .
quests.hint: This is a 8-word statement ending in 'expected' -- find the subject first, then the verb.
quests.explanation: 'Faster than we expected' compares the actual speed to what you predicted.
